author: Niczemny
quote: This is a significant step backward compared to the previous installment. The game has been drastically sanitized: you can no longer use the services of prostitutes, nor can you drive into a crowd of protesters. If you try to steal a car and the woman inside has a panic attack, you’re forced to walk away because you can’t pull her out or simply shoot her; furthermore, there are no intimate scenes—the screen just fades to black instead. The first 10 hours of the game are absurdly boring and slow-paced. The protagonist, Jason, is a total cuckold and an idiot, making him impossible to like. The game also lacks the brilliantly executed heists that were a highlight of GTA V. The shooting is much worse than in GTA V. The game is very poorly optimized and has an absurd number of bugs. Female fantasy with cars and guns crafted so as not to offend anyone.
